guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, tlram_rdata is asynchronously cleared to all zeros.
When not in reset, if tlram_req is high and tlram_we is low, tlram_rdata is updated with the endian-converted value of tlram_rdata_endian using conv_endian32 and endian_swap_i.
When not in reset and (tlram_req is low or tlram_we is high), tlram_rdata retains its previous value (implicit hold).

assumptions.claim: When tlram_req is asserted and tlram_we is deasserted, the inputs tlram_rdata_endian and endian_swap_i must be stable and valid around the rising clock edge.
assumptions.risk: If timing is violated, tlram_rdata may capture corrupted or metastable data, leading to incorrect downstream processing.

uncertain_points.claim: tlram_rdata is updated only on a read transaction but no valid/ready handshake signal is generated by this chunk. Downstream logic may sample stale or reset (all-zero) data without knowing if a read has occurred.
uncertain_points.cond: After reset or after an idle period without reads
uncertain_points.risk: If tlram_rdata holds a secret or key material from a previous read or defaults to zero, a consumer could use unintended data, potentially exposing sensitive internal state or allowing bypass of security checks.
